introduction: NM Energy$mart provides qualifying home-efficiency work through regional providers. Submit the household application to the provider serving your location, rather than to Housing New Mexico.
description: NM Energy$mart provides qualifying home-efficiency work through regional providers. Submit the household application to the provider serving your location, rather than to Hous

sections.who: Eligible homeowners and renters are considered under program income and property rules. Rental work requires landlord consent and a signed agreement before services can proceed.
sections.get: The program provides selected energy-saving retrofits and home modifications at no charge to eligible residents. Assessment determines suitable work; it is different from a cash utility award.
sections.docs:
• Income and household records requested by the provider.
  • Home address and energy information.
  • Ownership or tenancy details.
  • Landlord consent and the provider’s rental agreement if renting.
sections.apply:
1. Identify the provider

    Use the county and tribal service-area list.

  2. Request and submit intake

    Central New Mexico Housing Corporation serves the listed northern area, Southwestern Regional Housing the southern area, and Red Feather the Navajo Nation route.

  3. Complete property assessment

    Ask about scheduling, approved measures and any condition that must be resolved before work.
sections.after: Save your application copy and provider contact. Ask about waiting-list updates and post-work inspection and maintenance.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Energy$mart household intake and regional providers, Energy$mart service purpose. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Do I mail my household application to Housing New Mexico?
No. Its application page says to submit directly to the local service provider.
Yes, subject to eligibility, landlord consent and the required rental agreement.
Which route serves Navajo Nation residents?
The current directory lists Red Feather Development Group.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
